<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>

    <!-- Enable Microsoft Testing Platform with xunit v3 -->
    <UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner>true</UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Package versions come from Directory.Packages.props -->
    <!-- When using Microsoft Testing Platform, DON'T use Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk -->
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Content Include="xunit.runner.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest"/>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Using Include="Xunit"/>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\src\Yubico.YubiKit.Management.csproj"/>
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
